page.notes: Marginal text on the left edge is show-through from the facing page and was not transcribed. The word "bout" at the foot is a line-end fragment ("bounty" or similar), reproduced as printed. Greek word in line "Ἀρχι-ποίμην" is a best reading of a damaged Greek word and is doubtful. Some words in the text are doubtful due to print quality, e.g. "controuerf." and "miseri" are as printed.
